ambiguity.detail: The line 'You have taken my place today' hints at a complex backstory of sacrifice.

verdict.hook_line: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A loyal husband tends to his injured wife's wounds and swears a dark oath of vengeance.
verdict.why_it_works: Delivers emotional payoff, tender intimacy, and transitions cleanly into a menacing setup for payback.
